import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import path from 'node:path';

const root = '/tmp/sharpforge-a03-nested-type-references';
const baselineRoot = '/tmp/sharpforge-a03-nested-type-reference-baseline';
const evidence = '/tmp/a03-nested-type-references-validation';
assert.match(process.version, /^v24\./, 'Qualification requires Node 24');
assert.equal(process.env.SHARPFORGE_MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS, '1');
assert.equal(process.env.SHARPFORGE_TEST_CONCURRENCY, '1');
assert.equal(process.env.SHARPFORGE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_MB, '1024');
mkdirSync(evidence, { recursive: true });
const records = [];
function run(label, command, args, expected = 0, cwd = root) {
  const log = path.join(evidence, `${label}.log`);
  writeFileSync(log, '', { flag: 'wx' });
  const started = new Date().toISOString();
  const result = spawnSync(command, args, { cwd, env: process.env, encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024 });
  writeFileSync(log, result.stdout + result.stderr);
  records.push({ label, command, args, cwd, started, completed: new Date().toISOString(),
    exitCode: result.status, signal: result.signal, error: result.error?.message });
  writeFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'commands.json'), JSON.stringify(records, null, 2) + '\n');
  process.stdout.write(`${label}: ${result.status}\n${result.stdout}${result.stderr}`);
  assert.equal(result.status, expected, `${label}: unexpected exit`);
  assert.equal(result.signal, null, `${label}: signal`);
  return result;
}
const node = (label, args, expected) => run(label, process.execPath, args, expected);
run('install', 'npm', ['ci', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-audit', '--no-fund']);
run('baseline-install', 'npm', ['ci', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], 0, baselineRoot);
assert.equal(realpathSync(path.join(root, 'node_modules/@sharpforge/cil')), realpathSync(path.join(root, 'packages/cil')));
assert.equal(realpathSync(path.join(baselineRoot, 'node_modules/@sharpforge/cil')),
  realpathSync(path.join(baselineRoot, 'packages/cil')));
const inputs = ['tests/a03-07-nested-type-references.test.js', 'tests/fixtures/a03-nested-type-references/input.js', 'tests/fixtures/a03-nested-type-references/member-input.js',
  'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-nested-type-references.mjs'];
for (const file of inputs) {
  mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(baselineRoot, file)), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(path.join(baselineRoot, file), readFileSync(path.join(root, file)));
}
const sourcePaths = ['packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-types/snapshot.js', 'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-types/results.js',
  'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-types/local-references.js',
  'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-types/tokens.js', 'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-types/hierarchy.js',
  'packages/cil/src/verify/member-system.js', 'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-members/snapshot.js',
  'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-members/resolve.js', 'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-members/nesting.js',
  'packages/cil/src/verify/type-system.js', 'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-verifier-types.mjs',
  'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-local-type-references.mjs', 'tests/fixtures/a03-local-type-references/input.js',
  'tests/fixtures/a03-verifier-members/inherited-input.js', 'tests/managed-fixtures.js',
  'tests/fixtures/a03-verifier-types/input.js', ...inputs];
const hash = value => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
const hashes = {};
for (const [name, directory] of [['baseline', baselineRoot], ['candidate', root]]) {
  const commit = spawnSync('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { cwd: directory, encoding: 'utf8' });
  assert.equal(commit.status, 0);
  hashes[name] = { commit: commit.stdout.trim(), files: Object.fromEntries(sourcePaths.map(file =>
    [file, hash(readFileSync(path.join(directory, file)))])) };
}
const localSource = 'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-types/local-references.js';
hashes.candidate.files[localSource] = hash(readFileSync(path.join(root, localSource)));
for (const file of ['packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-types/definition-names.js', 'packages/cil/src/verify/metadata-nesting.js']) {
  hashes.candidate.files[file] = hash(readFileSync(path.join(root, file)));
}
writeFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'hashes.json'), JSON.stringify(hashes, null, 2) + '\n');
const red = run('baseline-red', process.execPath, ['--test', '--test-concurrency=1',
  '--test-name-pattern=nested local TypeRefs share', 'tests/a03-07-nested-type-references.test.js'], 1, baselineRoot);
assert.match(red.stdout, /unknown/);
assert.match(red.stdout, /known/);
run('baseline-local-performance', process.execPath, ['--expose-gc', 'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-nested-type-references.mjs',
  path.join(evidence, 'baseline-local-performance.json')], 0, baselineRoot);
run('baseline-existing-performance', process.execPath, ['--expose-gc', 'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-verifier-types.mjs',
  path.join(evidence, 'baseline-existing-performance.json')], 0, baselineRoot);
run('baseline-local-alias-performance', process.execPath, ['--expose-gc', 'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-local-type-references.mjs',
  path.join(evidence, 'baseline-local-alias-performance.json')], 0, baselineRoot);
node('native', ['tests/fixtures/a03-nested-type-references/capture.mjs', path.join(evidence, 'native.json')]);
writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'tests/fixtures/a03-nested-type-references/native.json'), readFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'native.json')));
node('member-native', ['tests/fixtures/a03-nested-type-references/member-capture.mjs', path.join(evidence, 'member-native.json')]);
writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'tests/fixtures/a03-nested-type-references/member-native.json'), readFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'member-native.json')));
node('focused-tests', ['--test', '--test-concurrency=1',
  'tests/a03-07-nested-type-references.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-local-type-references.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-local-type-references-native.test.js',
  'tests/a03-07-type-system.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-type-system-native.test.js', 'tests/a03-verification-types.test.js',
  'tests/a03-07-members.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-members-inherited.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-type-access.test.js',
  'tests/a03-07-nested-access.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-member-access.test.js', 'tests/a03-coded-index-bounds.test.js']);
node('candidate-local-performance', ['--expose-gc', 'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-nested-type-references.mjs',
  path.join(evidence, 'candidate-local-performance.json')]);
node('candidate-existing-performance', ['--expose-gc', 'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-verifier-types.mjs',
  path.join(evidence, 'candidate-existing-performance.json')]);
node('candidate-local-alias-performance', ['--expose-gc', 'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-local-type-references.mjs',
  path.join(evidence, 'candidate-local-alias-performance.json')]);
node('manifests', ['scripts/planning/check-test-manifests.js']);
node('syntax', ['scripts/check.js']);
node('static-imports', ['scripts/conformance/static/check-imports.js', '--output', path.join(evidence, 'static-imports.json')]);
node('structure', ['scripts/quality/check-structure.js']);
run('diff-check', 'git', ['diff', '--check']);
console.log(`Validation evidence: ${evidence}`);
